stages.label: Recovery
stages.text: If your Land Rover is no longer driveable, we can arrange for it to be transported safely to our workshop.

stages.label: Workshop Arrival
stages.text: Once your Land Rover arrives, our technicians carry out initial inspections and diagnostics to assess the engine problem.

stages.label: Engine Removed
stages.text: Where a full rebuild is required, the engine is carefully removed, with relevant connections and components documented.

stages.label: Strip Down
stages.text: The engine is systematically dismantled, allowing internal components to be inspected for wear, damage and potential causes of failure.

stages.label: Machine Shop
stages.text: The engine block, cylinder head and other relevant components are measured and assessed. Precision machining is carried out where required.

stages.label: New Components Fitted
stages.text: Approved replacement components are fitted as needed, with critical clearances, assembly procedures and tightening specifications carefully checked.

stages.label: Testing
stages.text: After reassembly and installation, the engine undergoes appropriate mechanical, fluid-system and diagnostic checks to verify correct operation.

stages.label: Road Test
stages.text: Once workshop checks are complete, your Land Rover undergoes a controlled road test, where appropriate, to assess its performance under normal driving conditions.

stages.label: Collection
stages.text: Following final checks, your Land Rover is prepared for collection, with the completed work and relevant aftercare information explained.

footer.title: Every rebuild is documented. Every component is inspected.
footer.text: From initial diagnosis to final testing, our process is designed around careful workmanship, clear communication and reliable results.
